fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
When partners differ by 3 points, sales steps in

Moorhaven Home's quiz asks each partner to rate the firmness they like on a 10-point scale. When the ratings differ by 3 or more, a salesperson gets a Slack alert with both sets of answers and calls the couple. In March, 23 of the 90 couples who took the quiz got that call.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: A furniture store's couples quiz compares each partner's firmness rating out of 10, and when two ratings differ by 3 or more a salesperson gets a Slack alert; 23 of 90 couples did in March.

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: A mattress review site's March count shows 1,240 quiz takers, 512 on soft foam and 391 on hybrid, and the editor puts 3 soft foam models on April's review list.
